publisher_preprocessing.finding: MS notebook reads completed CSVs, assigns TLS/certificate variant from directory name and retains command column; no verified per-session label mapping or raw-capture join in inspected code.

references.finding: TCP length passed to packet summary and accumulated byte count is transport payload size.
JSON packet b uses saved payload size; ipt is a millisecond inter-entry delta; output may omit zero-length packets and has per-direction summary limit.
TLS record types/timing are separate from IP packets; ClientHello metadata is emitted at flow export, without an explicit matching packet/event index in this derivative.

joy_semantics.scope_caveat: Code revision is pinned current public source, not cryptographic proof of the exact binary which made the derivative. File configuration identifies version 4.5.0.
